name: Daily Calcudoku
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Calcudoku is an online game for our math-loving community! If you are a fan of sudoku games and math in general, then you will love this daily game. Start your morning or end your night with a daily mathematical challenge. There are four options to play: 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, and 8x8. There is a challenge for every level of difficulty you could want. If you want to play easy or if you want a challenge, then it is your choice. You can also play and solve all four if you just love sudoku games. Do not hesitate to play this challenging sudoku game!
